steps: Rinse 200 g of quinoa under cold water using a fine-mesh sieve.
Combine quinoa and 400 ml of water in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 15 minutes until water is absorbed.
Peel and finely dice the onion; mince the 2 garlic cloves.
Cut 300 g of chicken into small, even pieces, about 1 cm thick.
Heat 15 ml of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; cook onion and garlic for 3 minutes until softened.
Add chicken pieces, cumin and turmeric; cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until no pink remains.
Pour in 200 ml of coconut milk and add 80 g of spinach; stir and cook for 2 minutes until spinach wilts.
Spoon cooked quinoa into bowls and ladle the chicken and coconut mixture over the top.
Serve warm; store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
